_comment: The relationship-shape taxonomy, plus hand labels for the boards that
shipped before agents recorded a `shape` per pair.
Counts are NOT stored here — they are recomputed on demand by
studio/variety.js from what shipped and what runs produced, so there is no
second mutable file to drift out of step with the runs themselves.
Taxonomy is the Studio spec's eight shapes plus the GDD section 10.1
relationship types that were not already covered.

shapes.description: One thing becomes another through a process
A component and the thing it belongs to
An instrument and the work or worker it serves
Something that acts and the result it produces
A raw material and the finished object made from it
An early stage and the developed form it grows into
A vessel and what it holds
A milder degree and its fuller counterpart
An emblem and what or whom it stands for
A maker and the thing they made
A place and the one who lives or works in it
Sameness, opposition, or a reversed direction
A word whose second sense carries the analogy
